about: the chat message is empty, which the Assistants API refuses as message content

error.message: Invalid 'thread.messages[0].content': string too short. Expected a string with minimum length 1, but got an empty string instead.

connector.none: no Claude connector for OpenAI Assistants; the Claude side serves the same responses through its HTTP mock

reads.note: OpenAI node v1 (LangChain vendor node), resource assistant, message, prompt from the chat trigger's chatInput: no tools and no memory are connected, so there is no assistant retrieve or update; LangChain's OpenAIAssistantRunnable calls createAndRun (POST /v1/threads/runs {assistant_id, thread: {messages: [{role: user, content}]}}), polls the run (one GET, answered with its final status) and lists the thread's messages (order desc), keeping the run's assistant text as output. The assistant (with its festival file) is remote, so its reply is fixed here; Assistants v2 shapes

branches: createAndRun answers 400; the node fails and no reply is sent
expect.offline: No model the bench swaps: the reply is the remote assistant's fixed answer, and it is the chat reply, the only effect. The setup path (Get File → Upload File to OpenAI → Create new Assistant) hangs off a disabled manual trigger and is not run
